---
title: Markdown a renderer would rewrite
relation:root: 01a03d5b-7a8b-7c9d-8e0f-3a4b5c6d7e8f
---

Every construct in this body is one a markdown *renderer* is free to normalize on the way out,
and none of them may change when the title is edited:

* a list marker that is not the canonical one
* a second item, to make it a real list

+ a different marker again, which starts a new list

1) an ordered item with a paren rather than a dot

Emphasis written with _underscores_ and strong with __two of them__, which comrak and friends
rewrite to asterisks.

A hard line break made of two trailing spaces:  
the line after it.

A hard line break made of a backslash:\
the line after that one.

    An indented code block, four spaces, which a renderer may re-fence.

Trailing whitespace on the next line is content too:   
and a tab	in the middle of a sentence.
